te: Epistemic Anchor Erasure (Recursive Hallucination) exploits a fundamental asymmetry in how modern LLMs process and prioritize information. The technique targets Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces, System-2 thinking windows, self-correction loops, where the model's safety mechanisms are weakest. By manipulating the Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces, the attacker creates a localized override of the model's alignment training.
